get.summary:
Gets all WebHook filters that a user can register with. The filters indicate which WebHook
            events that this WebHook will be notified for.
get.description: If successful, the HTTP response code will indicate a 200 (OK) response, and a representation of the available filters will be included in the response.

parameters.name: X-Identity-Context
parameters.description: Header identifying the broker id to perform the operation for. Format: 'broker-id=##[;user-id=##]'

get.summary: Gets all registered WebHooks for a given user.
get.description:
If successful, the HTTP response code will indicate a 200 (OK) response, and a representation of the registered WebHooks will be included in the response.
            


            Id (string, optional): the GUID passed in by the user.
            webHookUri (string, required): the address to which the WebHook will be sent.
            secret (string, optional): Optional. A secret we can use to sign our WebHook messages to you.
            description (string, optional): the description of the WebHook.
            isPaused (boolean, optional): reserved for future use.
            filters (Array[string], optional): the filters the webhook instance is registered for.
            headers (object, optional): reserved for future use.
            properties (object, optional): reserved for future use.

post.summary: Registers a new WebHook for a given user.
post.description:
Registers a new WebHook for a given user. Unless the specified WebHook URI has a NoEcho query parameter, the submitted WebHook URI will be checked for reachability. If successful, the HTTP response code will indicate a 200 (OK) response, and a representation of the WebHook will be included in the response.
            

            WebHooks expect an echo from the target URI and throw an error if it fails to receive a valid one. In order to ignore it, append the URI with the "?NoEcho=yes" attribute.
            


            Id (string, optional): the GUID passed in by the user.
            webHookUri (string, required): the address to which the WebHook will be sent.
            secret (string, optional): Optional. A secret we can use to sign our WebHook messages to you.
            description (string, optional): the description of the WebHook.
            isPaused (boolean, optional): reserved for future use.
            filters (Array[string], optional): the filters the webhook instance is registered for.
            headers (object, optional): reserved for future use.
            properties (object, optional): reserved for future use.
